# Houdaifa Drahm

> Houdaifa Drahm is a Backend & DevOps Engineer from Morocco, studying at 1337 School (42 Network), UM6P in Benguerir. He builds backend services, real-time applications, deployment pipelines, and low-level C/C++ projects. Name sometimes spelled Hudayfa Draham or Houdaifa Draham; usernames houdaifadrahm and Houdaifa1.

## Skills

- Backend: Node.js, NestJS, REST APIs, WebSockets, Socket.io
- DevOps: Docker, Docker Compose, GitHub Actions CI/CD, Nginx with TLS, DigitalOcean
- Systems: C, C++, POSIX, multithreading, TCP/IP networking
- Databases: PostgreSQL, MariaDB
- Languages: Arabic, English, French

## Projects

- ft_transcendence (NETPONG): deployed multiplayer air hockey platform with NestJS, Socket.io, JWT auth and CI/CD
- Webserv: HTTP/1.1 server in C++ with non-blocking I/O and CGI
- Inception: multi-container Docker infrastructure with Nginx, MariaDB and WordPress
- Minishell: Unix shell in C
